description: The workspace packaging end to end. gen schema --kdlith-workspace generates a schema crate twice into byte-identical trees inside a scratch workspace whose root manifest names the kdlith crates under [workspace.dependencies] (here as paths to the copied crates), compiles it with the inherited dependencies and lints, and reads the committed data document through the generated reader; --kdlith-workspace with --kdlith-path, and with --kdlith-version, each fail closed with KDLITH-CLI002 and write nothing. Then gen workspace, run in a consumer whose root manifest carries the four expected git lines, writes the owned .cargo/config.toml from an override naming the repository checkout: its first line is the kdlith marker, it warns KDLITH-LOC009, and it patches the kdlith git source with one path entry under <checkout>/pkg/rs per crate. The closure guard computes, from the repository's own cargo metadata resolve graph (normal dependencies only), the kdlith crates a schema reader's four direct dependencies reach, and requires that list to equal the patch's crate list exactly: a crate missing from the patch would resolve twice, an extra one is an unused patch. Finally gen workspace --check passes with the same override and reports KDLITH-GEN002 changed without it

command: "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out refused --kdlith-workspace --kdlith-path ../ws/rs; echo "exit=$?"; test -e refused || echo "refused absent"
stderr-contains: error[KDLITH-CLI002]: the argument '--kdlith-workspace' cannot be used with '--kdlith-path <PATH>'

command: "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out refused --kdlith-version 0.1.0 --kdlith-workspace; echo "exit=$?"; test -e refused || echo "refused absent"
stderr-contains: error[KDLITH-CLI002]: the argument '--kdlith-version <VER>' cannot be used with '--kdlith-workspace'

command: exec "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen schema inputs/schema.kdl --crate parts-proc --out ws/rs/parts-proc --kdlith-workspace
stdout-contains: ok: generated schema crate parts-proc at ws/rs/parts-proc (11 owned files)

command: cd consumer && "$KDLITH_FX_KDLITH" gen workspace --sources sources.kdl --override kdlith="$KDLITH_FX_REPO" && sed "s#$KDLITH_FX_REPO#<repo>#" .cargo/config.toml
stderr-contains: warning[KDLITH-LOC009]: source kdlith is overridden by

command: set -e; cargo metadata --offline --locked --format-version 1 --manifest-path "$KDLITH_FX_REPO/Cargo.toml" | jq -r '. as $m | ($m.packages | map({key: .id, value: .name}) | from_entries) as $name | ($m.resolve.nodes | map({key: .id, value: [.deps[] | select(any(.dep_kinds[]; .kind == null)) | .pkg]}) | from_entries) as $deps | [$m.packages[] | select(.name | IN("kdlith-diagnostic", "kdlith-engine", "kdlith-model", "kdlith-superproc")) | .id] as $start | {seen: $start, todo: $start} | until(.todo | length == 0; ([.todo[] | $deps[.][]] | unique) as $next | ($next - .seen) as $new | .seen += $new | .todo = $new) | .seen[] | $name[.] | select(startswith("kdlith-"))' | sort > closure.txt; sed -n 's/^\(kdlith-[a-z]*\) = .*/\1/p' consumer/.cargo/config.toml | sort > patched.txt; cat closure.txt; diff closure.txt patched.txt && echo closure-match
stdout-contains:
kdlith-diagnostic
kdlith-engine
kdlith-model
kdlith-parse
kdlith-runtime
kdlith-superproc
closure-match
